title: Reverse Shell Builder
subtitle: Generate one-liners, apply obfuscation, and save reusable configs.
scenario_subtitle: Pick the closest lab scenario. The builder will preselect a practical technique.

web.title: Web RCE
web.description: Command injection or web shell context

output_panel_hint: Run the listener first, then copy the payload command.
copy_receipt_body: Save this workflow or export a short engagement card if you will reuse it.
fit_reason_platform_mismatch: May not match the selected target OS.
payload_intro: Select the shell method that best matches the target profile.
technique_command_intro: Choose a compatible technique, optionally transform it, then copy the final command.
payload_search_placeholder: Search by language, platform, or technique...
payload_no_results: No techniques match the current filters.
attacker_victim_intro: Define the target constraints, then prepare the callback endpoint and listener.
attacker_intro: Set where the target should connect back.
target_profile_intro: Filter techniques by the target platform, architecture, available tools, and outbound network access.
random_port_hint: Random ports avoid common services such as SSH, HTTP/S, DNS, databases, Redis, Docker, and common dev ports.
target_profile_tools_hint: Leave tools unselected when you are not sure what exists on the target.
lhost_bind_hint: Not used for bind shells. Connect inbound to the target on LPORT.
lhost_staged_hint: HTTP server address that hosts your stage file (rs.sh).
lhost_http_hint: HTTP callback server address for HoaxShell-style polling.
lport_bind_hint: Port opened on the target. Connect with nc TARGET_IP LPORT.
obfuscation_intro: Apply an encoding or wrapper compatible with the selected technique.
recommended_listener_hint: Run this listener before executing the generated command.
recommended_listener_http_note: Use the HTTP callback server below instead of a TCP listener.
next_step_hint: Upgrade the shell, then clean up terminal behavior for a smoother session.
tty_upgrade_hint: Copy these steps after the callback lands to improve interactivity without leaving the builder.
tty_upgrade_verified_note: Verified upgrade methods only. Cleanup helpers are separated below.
session_cleanup_hint: Use these helpers after the upgrade to fix terminal behavior, prompt output, or reconnect workflow.
generated_command_intro: Copy this command after confirming the target and listener settings.
raw_command_intro: Reference version before any transform is applied.
stage_file_hint: Host this file on your HTTP server, then run the staged command on the target.
http_server_hint: Download and run the included Python callback server. It serves commands on GET and accepts target output on POST.
invalid_input: Fix invalid input to generate a command.
validation_error: Fix the highlighted fields to generate a command.
validation_field_lhost: Use an IP address or hostname without shell metacharacters.
validation_field_shell: Use a shell path without spaces or shell metacharacters.
validation_field_http_port: HTTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
obfuscation_note: Transforms are applied locally in your browser.
obfuscation_url_double: URL double encode - Nested decode contexts
obfuscation_bash_base64: Bash base64 - Decode then pipe to shell
obfuscation_bash_printf_hex: Bash printf hex - Rebuild with escapes
card_authorized_only: Use only in explicitly authorized environments.

obfuscation_notes.url: URL-encoded output for HTTP parameter or form contexts.
obfuscation_notes.url-double: Command URL-encoded twice for double-decoding contexts.
obfuscation_notes.bash-base64: Base64 wrapper decoded locally before execution.
obfuscation_notes.bash-base64-no-spaces: Bash base64 wrapper using minimal spaces.
obfuscation_notes.bash-ifs: Spaces replaced with '${IFS}' for shell argument filtering.
obfuscation_notes.bash-rev: Command is stored reversed and reconstructed with rev.
obfuscation_notes.bash-printf-hex: Command rebuilt from hex escape sequences with printf.
obfuscation_notes.powershell-concat: PowerShell command split into concatenated string chunks.
obfuscation_notes.powershell-base64: PowerShell decodes a UTF-8 base64 command before execution.
obfuscation_notes.python-chr: Command reconstructed from character codes before execution.
